definitions.gloss: gravel road; gravel path; unpaved road covered with gravel
definitions.explanation: A road or path surfaced with loose gravel rather than asphalt or concrete. Common in rural areas, parks, and shrine or temple grounds.

examples.japanese: {砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk on a gravel road.

examples.japanese: {砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Gravel roads are hard to ride a bicycle on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参道|さんどう}→参道：11980_sandou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}で、⟦{足音|あしおと}→足音：02991_ashioto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ジャリジャリ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The approach to the shrine was a long gravel path, and my footsteps crunched loudly.

notes:
USAGE:
A concrete, everyday noun. Gravel paths are characteristic of Japanese shrine and temple grounds, traditional gardens, and rural areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk on a gravel road)
- {砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to drive/run on a gravel road)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未舗装|みほそう}{道路|どうろ}: unpaved road — broader category including dirt and gravel
- ⟦{舗装|ほそう}{道路|どうろ}→舗装道路：29423_hosoudouro⟧: paved road — the opposite
